batch.description: Jahangirnagar University D Unit (Biological Sciences), academic session 2022-2023, Set-O — full 80-question paper transcribed from publisher compilation ju-a-unit-question-solution-2022-2023.pdf, PDF pages 20-24 (book pages 20-24): Short Syllabus questions on pp.20-23 plus Extra Syllabus questions on p.24 together complete Q1-80. Printed publisher answer keys ([Ans: x] / printed solutions) preserved as-is; NOT official JU keys. All contentVerificationStatus=unverified pending cross-source verification. Q32: printed solution states no correct option exists, recorded as no_correct_option. IQ questions keep source subject label 'IQ' per REPO_FINDINGS (non-canonical subjects keep source label); Botany/Zoology mapped to canonical Biology with split kept in topic. Cross-source verification 2026-10-31 vs Satt Academy: 57 of 80 questions publicly comparable; 52 content-verified and included in the import-ready copy. Answer keys: 53 agree in letter and content; Q37-Q39 keyed content agrees (Satt orders options b/c differently); ONE genuine key conflict — Q32: the compilation's printed solution states no listed option is correct, while Satt marks option a; following the JU A Set-I precedent, the independent source's value (a) is recorded and the answer is marked unverified. Q37-Q40 and Q70 have documented option-set/order/distractor differences and remain content-unverified (their keyed answers agree); 23 questions were not publicly readable on Satt and remain unverified; those 28 are excluded from the import-ready copy and remain in the archived full pack. Detail: VERIFICATION/SOURCE_EVIDENCE/ju-d-2022-2023-seto.VERIFICATION.md.

sourceDocuments.title: JU D Unit question & solution 2022-2023 (Set-O), publisher question-bank compilation via AdmissionWar/TargetPDF
